mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies and 78 degrees near the Military Ridge State Trail, with an air quality index of 52, which is currently in the moderate range.

City engineering reports are updated regularly, and you can access these records on the Verona municipal website. Also, consider volunteering as a tri-shaw pilot for the Senior Center, or check out seasonal job openings at the recreation department.

It is a busy couple of days for local fun. Today, catch live music at Bailey's Run and the Wisconsin Brewing Company, or head to the Verona Ice Arena for the Girls Try Hockey event. Tomorrow, drop in for yoga at Insight Wellness.
In our weekly police report, we noted an incident on Thursday, July 31st, where a driver was arrested for O W I after being pulled over for having a flat tire and deactivated taillights.
The flavor of the day is Snickers Swirl. Culver's is open until 10 PM tonight, so you have plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
